item.title: Epstein Email Alleges Bill Gates Hid STD From Wife After Sex With ‘Russian Girls’
item.description: The emails, dated July 2013, were written by Epstein about Gates and sent to his own account with no indication they were ever sent to the Microsoft founder. The post Epstein Email Alleges Bill Gates Hid STD From Wife After Sex With ‘Russian Girls’ first appeared on Mediaite.

item.title: ’Speaker Johnson, I Won’t Forget This’: Lindsey Graham Threatens Top Republican for Thwarting Lawsuit
item.description: Lindsey Graham ended his blockade Friday preventing the Senate from passing the House funding package, but not before putting House Speaker Johnson on notice. item.title: Trump Insists Kristi Noem Is Taking Heat ‘Because She Is a Woman’
item.description: President Donald Trump alleged on Friday night that the criticisms lobbed against Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem are sexist in nature. The post Trump Insists Kristi Noem Is Taking Heat ‘Because She Is a Woman’ first appeared on Mediaite.
